## Design

This session, I worked on my Starbie PCB schematic in KiCad. I added the main components, organized the connections, labeled important signals, and marked pins I didn't use with no-connect X’s. I have attached screenshots of my progress!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 231710](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/QWQ0dzg9KtscDdtNGefWyaNfmzgR9wJZ/aae4b7622c0f2da60f8d64b38e2f9f313dd69bd386b5abd3ff7aec7f7df26f2c.png)

This session, I assigned footprints to my PCB components in KiCad, including the connectors, resistor, pushbuttons, and XIAO ESP32-C3. I worked on resolving footprint errors and prepared the components for the next stage of PCB layout, placement, and routing.

This session, I completed routing the PCB by connecting the component pads with copper traces. I also added a GND copper pour to fill the background inside the star-shaped board outline. These steps brought me closer to completing my Starbie PCB design.
